d.provenance: paper, text and Table 1: 2a = 0.8 um (1.0 um also studied)

dim.provenance: 3D: the profile IS the third dimension, and Carnahan-Starling is the 3D hard-sphere EOS

N.provenance: fixed by phi and the box, not chosen

L.provenance: = L_z. The confined axis, which is the box length every gate uses: exp(-L_z/l_g) is the lid weight and L_z l_g/D_0 is the settling time

L_xy.provenance: OURS, tier 3, approved by the user 2026-09-16

l_g.provenance: the paper's measured gravitational length, Table 1

T.provenance: ★ DERIVED, not assumed. The paper states no temperature. It states l_g

kT.provenance: reduced units: kT is the energy scale

eps_wca.provenance: WCA amplitude. eps=10 is 3x more accurate at phi=0.3 for 1.5x the cost; 1 is inside 2 % over THIS phi range

eta.provenance: ★ DERIVED from the paper's MEASURED D_0 = 0.44 um^2/s by Stokes-Einste

rho_fluid.provenance: paper, Table 1, the 70:30 decalin/TCE row. Used ONLY to make the tempe

rho_p.provenance: paper, Table 1: PMMA. Load-bearing here -- it sets Delta-rho and there

sigma_wall.provenance: Gaussian wall width. F_max = eps/(sigma sqrt(e)) is BOUNDED, which is the point -- an LJ wall reaches 1517 kT/d (bd-hoomd trap 22)

r_cut_wall.provenance: U(2 d) = 4.5e-9 kT, so the analysis windows start clean

sigma_lj.provenance: so the WCA minimum sits at r = d. sigma_LJ = 1 would make the effective diameter 1.1225 d and phi 1.414x too large

k_trap.provenance: NO TRAP. Nothing is held: the only external force is uniform gravity and the only confinement is the two walls

n_bonds.provenance: NO BONDS and no angles. 584 independent spheres; the only pair interaction is the WCA core above

dt.provenance: the step in the run's own reference time, which is the number the integrator actually receives

dt_seconds.provenance: the same step dimensionally, so it can be read against gamma and D_t. ⚠ NOT compared against the spec -- see the unit note in bdbot.params.diff_against_spec

dt_star.provenance: set BY the WCA gate at U = 8 kT, not fitted to it: 2.0e-4 was refused by the hard check at 1.08x

n_eq.provenance: ZERO by design: the approach to equilibrium IS part of the measurement (stationarity in the primary arm, convergence in the ideal arm), so it is sampled rather than discarded blind

init.provenance: init='ideal' encoded 0=ideal-gas exponential, 1=CS hydrostatic profile. It is in `params`, so it is hashed into the run_id

seed_hoomd.provenance: ★ what HOOMD ACTUALLY uses: Simulation(seed=) truncates to 16 bits. Recorded because the spec hashes the untruncated value, so two runs could differ in name and share a noise stream

n_prod.provenance: production_tau_sed x tau_sed / dt, from the sealed document

seed.provenance: one of the sealed seed list

min_sep.provenance: RSA rejection radius. Uniform random placement threw a particle 39 d out of the box on the first thousand steps

D_t.provenance: kT/gamma, bdbot.materials.diffusion. The paper's measured D_0 is 0.44 um^2/s and eta was DERIVED from it, so this is a round trip and not independent evidence -- see the disclosure in prediction.yaml

tau_B.provenance: d^2/D_t. ⚠ NOT the governing timescale here -- tau_sed is

tau_fall.provenance: L_z l_g/D_0, the DRIFT time across the cell -- 9x tau_sed, and the reason the run starts from the analytic profile

tau_gov.provenance: the governing timescale is tau_sed: it is what T_obs is measured in
